observed_defects.title: Free users can see estimated finding value and open finding detail drilldowns
observed_defects.expected: The Free plan must hide Estimated Value and must not allow record-level finding detail pages to open.
observed_defects.actual: Estimated Value is visible in the findings list and the finding title opens the record-level detail page.
observed_defects.disposition: Fix before broad 50-customer go-live; does not invalidate fresh installation or scan execution evidence.
